g.text: Workflow 2: Inter-Location Transfer Lifecycle & Discrepancy Resolution
Enter measured weight (via BLE Scale or Keypad)
Add optional line notes (e.g., "شقف شاورما متبلة")
More items to add to manifest?
Revert reserved stock in Butcher ledger
Display toast: "تم إلغاء التحويل واستعادة الرصيد"
Display error: "لا يمكن الإلغاء، تم استلام الشحنة بالفعل"
Receive confirmation: "تم استلام الشحنة بنجاح من قبل المطعم"
Display variance alert on Butcher terminal
Log discrepancy deficit against Butcher ledger
Archive transfer into branch completed ledger
Weigh physical delivery cuts on kitchen scale
Enter verified received weight for each line item
Verified received weight matches sent weight?
Record receiving timestamp and recipient ID
System flags line discrepancy in RED
Click "Accept with Discrepancy / استلام مع تسجيل فرق"
